_taxonomy_meta.project: Intelligent Optimization of Data Pipelines using RAG-Based Knowledge Retrieval and Agentic Decision Systems
_taxonomy_meta.author: Mohammed Mudassirullah Sheriff
_taxonomy_meta.institution: BITS Pilani WILP — M.Tech Data Science & Engineering
_taxonomy_meta.description: Defines the complete category and subcategory taxonomy for Layer 1 of the knowledge base. The category and subcategory fields in every kb_entry must use values from this taxonomy exactly.

taxonomy.rationale: Highest input frequency; most query-driven optimization patterns

subcategories.description: Avoiding SELECT *, selecting only required columns to reduce I/O and memory
Pushing WHERE filters as early as possible in the execution plan
Join ordering, join types (broadcast vs shuffle), eliminating cartesian joins
Replacing correlated subqueries with joins or CTEs for better performance
Pre-aggregation, partial aggregation, avoiding redundant GROUP BY operations
EXISTS vs IN, UNION vs UNION ALL, NOT IN vs NOT EXISTS vs LEFT JOIN rewrites
Avoiding functions on indexed columns, writing SARGable predicates
Avoiding repeated full table scans, materializing intermediate results

taxonomy.rationale: Core to Comcast data engineering context; DAG and YAML workflow patterns

subcategories.description: Removing duplicate or unnecessary transformation steps in ETL pipelines
Parallelizing independent tasks, reducing critical path length in DAGs
Salting, repartitioning, skew join strategies for uneven data distribution
Reducing cross-node data movement in distributed pipeline execution
Breaking monolithic pipelines into reusable, independently testable units
Replacing full reloads with incremental or delta processing patterns

taxonomy.rationale: High impact on query performance; driven by schema and statistics metadata

subcategories.description: Choosing the right index type: B-tree, Hash, Bitmap, Composite
Identifying columns that would benefit from indexing based on query patterns
Removing redundant or unused indexes that slow down write operations
Parquet/ORC column statistics and bloom filters for selective scan optimization

taxonomy.rationale: High impact on large-scale table scan performance; key for distributed systems

subcategories.description: Choosing effective partition columns such as date, region, or category
Ensuring queries are written to leverage partition elimination at scan time
Avoiding too many small partitions — the small file problem in distributed storage
Efficient dynamic partition insertion patterns in ETL workflows

taxonomy.rationale: Overlaps SQL and ETL; reduces redundant computation and I/O significantly

subcategories.description: Caching repeated intermediate DataFrames or query results within a pipeline run
When to use materialized views vs live queries for repeated aggregation patterns
Caching small lookup tables as broadcast variables in Spark to avoid shuffles
Engine-level result caching in BigQuery, Redshift, and Trino

taxonomy.rationale: Log-driven analysis; good variety for evaluation experiments

subcategories.description: Executor sizing, memory configuration, and parallelism tuning for pipeline jobs
Optimizing retry logic, timeout configuration, and failure isolation strategies
Avoiding scheduling conflicts and optimizing DAG trigger timing in Airflow
Identifying long-running tasks and slow operators from execution log analysis

taxonomy.rationale: Metadata-driven; rounds out coverage of storage-layer inefficiencies

subcategories.description: Parquet vs ORC vs Avro vs CSV — guidance on when to use each format
Snappy vs GZIP vs ZSTD — trade-offs for read-heavy vs write-heavy workloads
Compaction strategies using coalesce and repartition to reduce small file overhead
Clustering, sorting, and Z-ordering techniques for scan efficiency

_hld_coverage_check.description: Confirms all example optimizations listed on the HLD diagram are covered by this taxonomy

mappings.hld_output: Rewrite query to reduce nested subqueries or cartesian joins
Change join order / use broadcast join
